_comment: Machine-specific facts for the multi-session validation (scripts/mcp_multisession_e2e.py, MAME 0.289). The server contains none of these. Shinobi addresses and inputs come from the same declared maps recorded in shinobi.json (checkpoint_input) and 1942 from 1942.json; nothing here claims a RAM byte is unused by the game beyond what those profiles already verified.

extra_start.note: started after one session was stopped and a start failed, to show the slot is reusable

corrupt_rom_system.note: a system the real ROM collection does not hold; the harness places a corrupt pacman.zip in an extra ROM directory so MAME itself fails the start

capture.note: 68000 level-4 autovector handler, hit about every frame (shinobi.json maincpu.handler_pc)

ram.note: plain RAM in the declared map (shinobi.json checkpoint_input.ram)

rom_read.note: 68000 vector table: initial SP and PC

capture.note: per-frame RST 10h handler, about 60 per second (1942.json maincpu.frame_handler_pc)
